name: Cushion 45 × 45, velvet
notes: Own design, not a specific product: a 45 × 45 cm velvet throw cushion with a plump middle, light blue like the small channel-tufted armchair and the Riga. It leans back about 18°, so its box is 45 × 21 × 44 cm. Put it on the seat of a sofa or an armchair (the Loretto, Colette and other sofas and armchairs with a seat surface); it then moves with them. Duplicate it for more.
